channel.title: Relay Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for Relay on macOS.

item.description:
# Relay 0.3.18
- A compact solid background and soft shadow bring the screenshot editor together, while the bottom toolbar stays close to the image. - Discard closes a screenshot without saving it to Desktop or changing the clipboard. Previously saved copies are kept. - Copy & Close still saves to Desktop and copies the screenshot before closing. - The text-size popup has proper padding, a larger custom pixel-size field, evenly spaced presets, and a highlighted current size.
Tool shortcuts and Shift+Enter multiline text remain available.

## Floating screenshot editor
- A background-free editor with soft shadows around the screenshot and floating controls. - The bottom toolbar stays 12 points below the image as the window changes size. - Tool keys: V for Move, A for Arrow, D for Draw, R for Shape, T for Text. Typing in text annotations keeps these letters as text. - Text sizes in exported-image pixels, with ten presets and a custom value. - Shift+Enter adds a new line; Enter finishes editing. Multiline text stays intact in the saved image. - Copy & Close saves to Desktop, copies the annotated image and closes. Copy and Save keep the editor open.
Native area selection, the size readout and Space-drag remain included. Further capture-smoothness improvements are still being investigated.

## Screenshot editor
- A compact floating bottom toolbar gives more space to the image, with discreet icons and tooltips. - Color and size controls stay together; the size menu switches between line thickness and text size for the selected tool or mark. - Copy & Close is beside Copy at the top right. It copies the annotated image, saves it to Desktop, and closes the editor. Failed export keeps the image open. - Copy and Save continue to leave the editor open.
The native macOS area selector, pixel-size readout and Space-drag from 0.3.15 remain included. This update focuses on the editor layout; further capture-smoothness improvements are still being investigated.
